verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents an Export API where a developer picks an export type and a start/end date. The export types include CUSTOMER, SCREENING_AND_MONITORING_CASES and TRANSACTION_MONITORING_CASES_AND_ALERTS. Customers can be looked up by external identifier, and a case audit-trail endpoint exists, so the core of exporting customer, case and alert data for reconciliation is delivered. missing for 10: explicit evidence that case decisions are included in export files, documented export schema confirming stable identifiers in exported records, independent or hands-on corroboration; the 5-second download-URL TTL also adds integration friction.
